Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have for you from the fourth game of this series and just one last game to go. India have already sealed the series and will be looking to end on a high. West Indies will be playing for pride and that game will be on 7th of August at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). Do join us early for the build up. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Rohit Sharma, the Indian skipper says that it was pleasing how they played this game especially since it was not easy and they did well to reach a good total. Credits the bowlers for exploiting the conditions well and keeping the pressure by taking wickets. Says that with a batting line-up like what West Indies have, it is never easy to set a target. When asked about Avesh, he says that they do understand his talent and know what quality he has. Goes on to say that anyone can have a couple of bad games but they will always back their players and give them enough opportunities to try and prove themselves. Ends by thanking the crowd for their support and says there is another game to go.

Avesh Khan is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant spell with the ball. He says that he is feeling good after this game as he did not bowl well in the last few games but he stick to his hard lengths in this game and he got the right results. Tells that he has the backing of the team management and adds that they wanted him to make a strong comeback and he is happy with his performance and looking forward to doing well in the last game. Informs that it was stopping a bit off the surface and applauds the crowd for their support throughout this game and the series.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies says that India got to a flying start and they bowled well to come back in the game. Says that they could have chased down the total if they had built partnerships but that did not happen. When asked about his run out he says that it is not nice get to a start and then get run out. Says that it is a learning experience for the whole team. When asked about Dominic Drakes, he says that he is glad he is taking his opportunity and even performed well in the previous game. He also mentions Akeal Hosein and says that he has been doing really well for them. Congratulates India and says that they played well and that they need to learn from them. Says that they need to prepare well for the last game and take the opportunity to win. Admits that they still don’t have all the pieces in place and they need to work things out before the World Cup.
Time for the Presentation.

Earlier in the game, India got to a big total after they displayed their aggressive batting approach yet again quite convincingly. Almost all India batters contributed with Akeal Hosein and Joseph bowling decently for the Windies. However, just like in the batting department, Indian bowers also worked as a team and powered India to series win here at Florida.

India were absolutely clinical with the ball. There were a lot of questions before the game about Avesh Khan’s place in the Indian playing XI and the young man has answered all those questions with the ball in this game. He got two early wickets in the Powerplay and then there was a big misunderstanding between Pooran and Mayers that gifted India a big wicket of the West Indies skipper. Indian bowlers then, never let the Windies get back in this game as Arshdeep Singh, Bishnoi and Axar Patel along with the experienced Bhuvneshwar Kumar all did their job perfectly as India completed a convincing performance with the ball.

West Indies had a tough task in front of them at the halfway mark. However, they do have a strong and powerful batting line-up and they would have fancied their chances of chasing down this total. They came out all guns blazing and went onto score 61 runs in the Powerplay. The problem though was they lost three wickets in that phase and continued to lose wickets at regular intervals throughout their innings. Most of the batters got off to starts but no one really made it count and in the end, they folded out for just 132.

India seal the series with a dominating win! They had a good total on the board but they still needed to bowl well as the pitch was quite flat and the boundaries on this ground are pretty short. The Indian bowlers executed their plans perfectly and in the end, West Indies have fallen well short of the target.

OUT! BOWLED! Arshdeep Singh finishes things off in style as he nails another yorker! He bowls another inswinging yorker into middle and leg. It is too good for Obed McCoy as he misses it completely while trying to power it away. The ball knocks over the stumps and India win by 59 runs! This has been an absolutely dominating performance by the Indian team and Arshdeep Singh has been outstanding, ending with three wickets. They now take a 3-1 unassailable lead in the series.
Time for the final over of this game!
Goes full once again and outside off, Alzarri Joseph taps this towards point. Deepak Hooda concedes four runs in his solitary over.
Flights this one full outside off, Obed McCoy looks to go leg side and gets a leading edge towards point. Falls in the gap and they take a run.
Goes full and angles this into the left-hander, Obed McCoy looks to swing and misses. Gets hit on his back leg.
Short once again and outside off, Alzarri Joseph cuts this hard towards deep cover for a single.
This is short and outside off, Obed McCoy goes back in the crease and thumps the ball to long off for a run.
Deepak Hooda serves this full and angling into the stumps, Alzarri Joseph clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Deepak Hooda has been brought into the attack.
A full toss on middle. Obed McCoy tries to push it away but ends up getting no timing on this one.
It's a yorker again, outside off. Obed McCoy looks to dig it out but misses again.

NOT OUT! The umpire has to reverse his decision as the Ball Tracking shows that the ball pitched outside leg. This is a yorker, around leg. Obed McCoy looks to dig it out but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger. However, the decison is reversed after Obed McCoy takes the DRS.
A low full toss, around off. Obed McCoy blocks it out with an angled blade.
Obed McCoy is the last man to make his way out to the middle.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! What a find this man is for India! He keeps on nailing those yorkers at will. This is right in the blockhole angling into middle. Dominic Drakes looks to dig it out but it is too good for him and the ball goes onto shatter the stumps. Arshdeep Singh is happy as he gets his second wicket and India are just one wicket away now from sealing this game and the series.

Just short of the fielder at mid off. A slower low full toss angling into leg from 'round the wicket. Alzarri Joseph looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge towards mid off. The ball falls short of Hooda and a single is taken.
Arshdeep Singh is back on.

FOUR! Dominic Drakes finally gets one away! Axar Patel flights this one as well on middle and off, Dominic Drakes goes for the sweep and gets this towards deep backward square leg for four runs. Axar Patel has been expensive conceding 48 runs but took two wickets as well.
This one is also flighted into the pads, Alzarri Joseph waits for this and clips this down to fine leg for a run.
Angled into the pads once again, Dominic Drakes looks for the sweep and gets it off his pads towards fine leg for a leg bye.
WIDE! Strays down leg stump, Dominic Drakes looks to flick and misses. This has been called wide as well.
WIDE! Fires this one wide outside off, Dominic Drakes reaches for it and goes under his bat but the umpire says it is too wide.
This is short as well and on middle and leg, Dominic Drakes looks to sweep and inside edges the ball onto his body.
This is a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Dominic Drakes looks to pull and misses as it hits his body.
Axar Patel flights this full and angles this into the stumps, Alzarri Joseph knocks this down to long on for a single.
Goes fuller and on middle and leg. Alzarri Joseph flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Angles it into middle and leg. It is shorter in length and Alzarri Joseph mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
Goes fuller, on off. Alzarri Joseph drives it to the mid off fielder.

NOT OUT! Avesh Khan lands it on a good length and it nips back in sharply into middle. Alzarri Joseph looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal from Avesh Khan, It is not a loud one though but Rohit Sharma decides to take a review after the umpire does not give it out.  The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracking rolls and it shows that it is umpire's call on wicket's hitting. So the original decision stays and Alzarri Joseph can continue.
Goes tad fuller and outside off. Drakes steers it towards third man for a single.
Lands on a good length and outside off. Drakes looks to defend it away but misses.
Alzarri Joseph walks out to the middle and Avesh Khan is also back into the attack.

OUT! TIMBER! What a comeback from Ravi Bishnoi! He has his man and is absolutely thrilled! Ravi Bishnoi bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Shimron Hetmyer goes back to cut this but it is not short enough. Goes under his bat and crashes against the stumps. Shimron Hetmyer can not believe that this is bowled and the umpires check. The replays show that the ball as hit the stumps and Shimron Hetmyer has to leave! West Indies will know that any chance of winning this game has been extinguished. Ravi Bishnoi picks up the second wicket in this over and what a spell this has been.

SIX! This one has been dismissed from sight! Ravi Bishnoi floats this one full and outside off, Shimron Hetmyer moves his front foot out of the way and thumps it over long off for a biggie! Shimron Hetmyer is standing tall here through his team's collapse.
FOUR! Ravi Bishnoi goes short and wide outside off, Shimron Hetmyer slashes this well towards the deep cover fence for a boundary. He finally gets one away.
Ravi Bishnoi goes full and on the pads, Shimron Hetmyer looks to slog sweep this one and doesn't connect. Balloons off the pads to the leg side.
Ravi Bishnoi flights this one full and on a leg stumps line, Shimron Hetmyer fends this back down the pitch.
Dominic Drakes walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! And just like that, another one bites the dust! Ravi Bishnoi has bowled wonderfully tonight and is finally rewarded! He flights this one full on middle and off, Akeal Hosein swings but does not get any connection as this flies straight in the hands of Suryakumar Yadav at long on. It looks like this game is going only one way and if West Indies are to get over the line it will be all upto Shimron Hetmyer.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Ravi Bishnoi

Commentary.Commentary: A bit of misunderstanding between the batters but no damage done in the end. Kumar bowls it short and it is a slower one again. Shimron Hetmyer looks to pull it but is too early into his shot. The ball goes off the toe-end of his blade towards mid off. Shimron Hetmyer first looks for a single but is send back by his partner after the latter takes some stride forward. However, Shimron Hetmyer gets back in his crease before Pant whips the bails off as the throw came towards the batter's end.
Serves it short, on middle. Akeal Hosein pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Now he bowls a superb slower delivery! Lands it on a fullish length and outside off again. Akeal Hosein looks to drive it away but is beaten by the lack of pace.
Wow! A brilliant wide yorker! Akeal Hosein looks to dig it out but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Shimron Hetmyer drags it towards long on for another single.
Lands on a length, outside off. Akeal Hosein drills it to long off for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back into the attack.
Ravi Bishnoi ends with a really full delivery in line with the stumps, Akeal Hosein digs this out to deep cover for a single. Ravi Bishnoi ends an outstanding over with just two runs coming from it.
Goes full this time and just outside off, Shimron Hetmyer looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge short of the cover fielder. They take a quick single and finally get a run in this over.
Ravi Bishnoi serves this short once again and outside off, Shimron Hetmyer can not get this away as he hits this straight to the point fielder.
This is short and wide outside off, Shimron Hetmyer reaches for it and hits it straight to cover.
Quicker delivery bowled full and in line with the stumps, Shimron Hetmyer taps this back to the bowler's left.
Ravi Bishnoi flights this one full outside off, Shimron Hetmyer fends this uppishly back towards the bowler.

Follows a yorker with a slower delivery. It is on a length, on middle. Akeal Hosein is outfoxed by the change of pace and gets hit high on the pads as he looks to defend. West Indies now need 91 from 48 balls!
What an over this has been! He bowls a inswinging yorker, into middle. Akeal Hosein only manages to block it out.
On a length, around off. Akeal Hosein defends it with the angled blade towards point.
Almost a yorker on middle. Akeal Hosein defends it off the bottom of his blade back to the bowler. Singh stops it with his boot.
Akeal Hosein makes his way out to the middle with West Indies in a spot of bother.

OUT! CAUGHT! What an inspired bowling change from Rohit Sharma! Arshdeep Singh comes back into the attack and provides a vital breakthrough! He comes 'round the wicket and bowls it on a fullish length, outside off. Holder craves it uppishly towards sweeper cover where Sanju Samson runs forward and takes the catch comfortably. West Indies lose their sixth wicket and they still need 91 from 52 balls!
Commentary.Howout: c Sanju Samson b Arshdeep Singh

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and outside off. Shimron Hetmyer drives it to deep cover for a single.
Arshdeep Singh is back on. One over for 10 runs so far.

FOUR! Rubs salt to injury here! Ravi Bishnoi flights this one full and outside off, Jason Holder makes room and thumps it past the cover fielder as the ball races to the deep cover fence for four more runs. 12 runs of the over with 10 coming of the last two balls.

SIX! Ravi Bishnoi flights this one full on middle, Jason Holder connects but still gets an inside edge that flies towards deep square leg. Arshdeep Singh comes running towards the ball gets his hand on it to the left. Just boounces out of his hands and goes over the fence. That will go down as a dropped catch.
Ravi Bishnoi goes for a quicker googly once again angling into the stumps, Jason Holder mistimes his heave towards mid-wicket.
Googly this time angling down leg, Jason Holder gets his front leg out of the way and looks to heave this leg side. Misses and gets hit on his pads.
Ravi Bishnoi slights this one full outside off, Jason Holder goes across the line and paddles this towards fine leg for a brace.
Ravi Bishnoi bowls this short and in line with the stumps, Jason Holder mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket.

DRINKS! India are in complete control of his game at the moment. They have managed to take wickets at regular intervals and that has dented the Windies progress in this chase. However, they still have Holder and Shimron Hetmyer at the crease and we all know what they are capable of. West Indies though still need 104 from 60 balls and they need a special effort from the batters at the crease now to level this series here. Ravi Bishnoi is back into the attack.
This is on a good length and outside off, Shimron Hetmyer works this towards cover-point. There should have been a single but they do not run.
Four! That is a top shot! Avesh Khan goes back to bowling short and in line with the stumps, Shimron Hetmyer goes on the back foot and slaps this towards deep mid-wicket for a much-needed boundary.
Serves this full and outside off, Shimron Hetmyer connects this well and strokes this wide of cover. Rohit Sharma does well to dive and stop this.
Avesh Khan bangs this in short and angles the ball into the batter. Jason Holder pulls the ball towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Goes very full and outside off. Shimron Hetmyer drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller and outside off. Shimron Hetmyer drives it off the bottom of his blade to covers.
Avesh Khan is back on.
Flights this one full and outside off, Jason Holder fends this back to the left of the bowler.
Jason Holder walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rovman Powell has to depart after a short cameo! Rovman Powell will be disappointed as this was a full toss outside off. He could have hit it anywhere but only manages to mistime it straight down the throat of long on. Deepak Hooda makes no mistake as he catches this with ease and West Indies have lost half their side here.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepak Hooda b Axar Patel

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Axar Patel serves this wide outside off to stay away from Rovman Powell's hitting arc This is adjudged wide by the umpire.

SIX! Another powerful shot from Powell! Patel bowls it short again and tries to stay away from the hitting-arc of Powell. However, Powell is good enough to tonk it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Angles it into leg. Powell looks to pull it away but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads.
SIX! This is all power from Powell! On the shorter side, around off. Powell stands still and powers it away over long off for a biggie.
This is fuller on middle. Powell skips down the track and heaves it towards cow corner for a couple.

Ravi Bishnoi bowls this a fraction short and wide outside off, Rovman Powell slashes this towards deep cover-point for a run and keeps strike. Good over comes to an end with just three runs coming from it.
Goes full and on a leg stump line, Shimron Hetmyer works this through square leg for a single.
Ravi Bishnoi is short once again and outside off, Rovman Powell guides this past the point fielder for a single.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Rovman Powell knocks this straight to the cover fielder.
Full once again outside off, Gets an outside edge, and hits the keeper's pads. rolls towards slip. Another dot ball.
Ravi Bishnoi serves this full and outside off, Rovman Powell swings across the line and misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kyle Mayers holes out at long off and the Windies lose their fourth wicket now! This is clever bowling from Patel. He bowls it wider outside off again. That makes Mayers to reach out towards that ball. He does so and looks to go big down the ground. However, he does not get the middle of his blade and gets the elevation in his shot but fails to clear the long off fence. Deepak Hooda there takes another fine catch and India now are right on top in this game. Shimron Hetmyer walks out to the middle now.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepak Hooda b Axar Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Darted on middle and Powell knocks it down to long on for a single.
Bowls away from the hitting-arc of the Mayers. He cuts this shorter-length delivery, outside off to deep point for a single.
On the shorter side, around leg. Mayers pulls it off the inside half of his blade to fine leg.
Keeps it a tad short again, on middle. Powell rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On the shorter side, on off. Powell goes back and defends it towards the off side.
On a length, around off. Powell pushes it towards point and takes a single. West Indies are 61/3 after the Powerplay!
Bowls a yorker this time. Right in the blockhole, around leg. Mayers looks to dig it out but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
On a length, around off. Powell punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Singh bowls it short and around leg. There is a big gap behind square on the leg side and Powell pulls it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Mayers looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the off side. A leg bye taken.

FOUR! Mayers hits this away for a boundary and it bring up the fifty for the Windies! Goes fuller and down the leg side. Mayers flicks it fine and the ball races away towards the fence for a boundary.
Rovman Powell walks out to the middle as Arshdeep Singh comes into the attack.

OUT! RUN OUT! What an anti-climax to the over! What an over it has been and what an unfortunate way for Nicholas Pooran to depart. Axar Patel flights this one nicely. It is fuller, outside off, Nicholas Pooran defends it and looks for a quick single towards cover to keep strike. Kyle Mayers takes off but then changes his mind. Nicholas Pooran is half way down the wicket. Sanju Samson rushes in from covers and throws under arm towards the keeper. Rishabh Pant collects and teases Nicholas Pooran to try and make it back but he is standing still and is fuming. What an over this has been with 22 runs and an unfortunate wicket.

SIX! Third six of the over! Axar Patel fires this one across the batter on a fuller length. Nicholas Pooran is down the wicket once again and gets this over the long off boundary for another maximum! This is pure carnage and India will be desperate to see the back of Nicholas Pooran. West Indies on the other hand will be loving this.

SIX! This is an exhibition of clean hitting! With the breeze this time. Axar Patel goes full and wide outside off, Nicholas Pooran swings and connects cleanly as this is deposited into stands at deep cover. Nicholas Pooran is looking really good! Does not seem like a good idea to bowl Axar Patel in the Powerplay.
This is full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran guides this towards backward point. A dot this time.

SIX! Follows it up with a maximum! Goes a fraction short and outside off, Nicholas Pooran is down the wicket in a flash as he lofts this high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie! This is against the wind but still manages to clear the boundary by a distance.

FOUR! Straight away Nicholas Pooran puts pressure on the spinner! Axar Patel flights this full and outside off, Nicholas Pooran sweeps this towards the deep-square leg fence for a boundary to start the over.
On a length, on off. Pooran drives it right of mid off for a single. Another superb over from Avesh Khan! Just 5 from it and a wicket!
Axar Patel has been brought into the attack.
WIDE! Bangs it short and down the leg side. Pooran looks to pull it away but misses.
Goes very full and outside off. Mayers steers it towards deep backward point for a single.
Lands on a length and around off. Pooran opens the face of his blade and guides it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Mayers pulls it wide of mid on for a single.
A low full toss, outside off. Mayers looks to drive it away but misses.
The skipper Nicholas Pooran makes his way to the crease and will be looking to rebuild this innings.

OUT! CAUGHT! Avesh Khan gets his second wicket and the move to send Devon Thomas at number 3 has not worked for the Windies. Khan serves a good length delivery, around off. Thomas looks to go over the infield towards the off side. However, he miscues it completely and the ball goes high in the air towards extra-cover. Deepak Hooda settles under it and takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepak Hooda b Avesh Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and it is a cutter this time. Mayers swings across the line but misses.
On a length, on off. Mayers drives it on the up and it goes aerially and past mid off. However, the fielder runs behind it and cuts it off as the batters get two.
Serves it on a good length, on off. Devon Thomas defends it towards mid off and takes a single.
On a length, on off. Mayers defends it towards the off side and takes a quick single. Bhuvi has started well in this over after an expesive first one.
Slower short ball, it is around leg and Mayers ducks under it.
Back of a length, on middle. Mayers looks to pull it away but misses. The ball goes over the stumps and to the keeper.
Lands on a length, on off. Thomas defends it towards point. Good start from Avesh Khan!
Avesh Khan bowls on a good length to the new batter, and just outside off, Devon Thomas fends the ball towards the cover fielder.
Devon Thomas walks out at number 3!

OUT! CAUGHT & BOWLED! Avesh Khan strikes and gets the dangerous-looking Brandon King! Avesh Khan bowls this on a length in line with the stumps. The ball gets stuck in the wicket and Brandon King is too early into his shot. The ball lobs back towards Avesh Khan who takes an easy catch. He draws first blood and West Indies have lost a big wicket.
Continues bowling back of a length and outside off, Brandon King guides this to short third man.

FOUR! Brandon King is looking really good here! Avesh Khan bangs this in short and wide outside off, Brandon King needs no invitation to hit this hard past backward point and collect another boundary to his name.

Avesh Khan khan begins with a full delivery angling down leg, Brandon King plays all over this one as it hits his pad. Huge appeal from the bowler and Rohit Sharma asks Rishabh Pant for his opinion. He says it will be going down leg and they choose not to review.
Avesh Khan to start from the other end.
This is back of a length and in line with the stumps, Kyle Mayers looks to work this leg side and misses. Hits his pads and falls into the pitch. 14 runs of the first over.

FOUR! Bhuvneshwar Kumar finally gets it right and draws an edge! There is no slip in place. He serves this one on a good length and angling away towards slip from an off stump line, Kyle Mayers looks to fend and gets a thick edge past the slip region to the third man fence for the third boundary of the over.
This is on a good length and wide outside off, Brandon King works this to the right of backward point and takes a single.

FOUR! That is a shot to admire! Bhuvneshwar Kumar goes full and just outside off, Brandon King gets a stride forward and punches this to the left of the bowler for a boundary straight to long off. What a start for West Indies.
This is slightly short as well and wide outside off, Brandon King slashes at this one as well and gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Smack! Bhuvneshwar Kumar overcompensates by going short and wide outside off, Brandon King has width to swing his arms and slashes this towards the backward point fence for a boundary!
WIDE! Bhuvneshwar Kumar begins with an inswinger going down leg. Brandon King leaves this alone and is called wide.
